lead: BRS packs and moves data centers, server racks, computers and other high-value technology, for moves across the hall or across the country.
card_blurb: Secure packing and transport of computers, server racks and high-value technology equipment.
meta_title: Computer and IT Moving Services | BRS
meta_description: BRS packs and moves computers, server racks, data centers and lab equipment, with disconnect, re-rack and secure transport for local or national moves.
overview: BRS crews move high-value IT equipment securely and safely. We pack and move data centers, server racks, server equipment, computers and related technology, plus lab equipment and other high-value gear.
Our IT moving services are flexible and can be customized to your requirements. Projects can be large or small, local or national.

benefits.title: Flexible, customizable service
benefits.text: We shape the move around your requirements and the challenges of your IT project.

benefits.title: Secure transport
benefits.text: Equipment is packaged and moved directly and securely.

benefits.title: Any distance
benefits.text: We support moves across the hall, across the street or across the country.

included: Packing and moving of data centers and server racks

process.title: Scope the move
process.text: We learn your requirements and the challenges of your IT project.

process.title: Disconnect and package
process.text: Equipment is disconnected, de-racked where needed, and packaged for transport.

process.title: Transport securely
process.text: Packed equipment travels directly and securely to the new site.

process.title: Reconnect and re-rack
process.text: We re-rack and reconnect equipment so you can get back to business.

who_for: Organizations moving server racks or data centers
Businesses with lab or other high-value technology equipment
Teams running local or national moves and migrations

faq.q: What equipment does BRS pack and move?
faq.a: We pack and move data centers, server racks, server equipment, computers, PCs and related technology, lab equipment and most other high-value technology equipment.

faq.q: Can BRS handle moves outside the local area?
faq.a: Yes. Our source describes moves across the hall, across the street or across the nation, and projects both local and national.

faq.q: Does BRS reconnect equipment after the move?
faq.a: Yes. We can disconnect, reconnect, de-rack and re-rack equipment, and provide packaging and direct secure transport.
